name: TECO SeaCoast Pipeline Project

values.StartLocation: Interconnects with Florida Gas Transmission and Southern Natural Gas pipelines, Florida
values.EndLocation: Greenland Energy Center, southeast Jacksonville, Duval County

researcher_notes: No row in the tracker under SeaCoast, TECO or Greenland. Not the Callahan line, which is a separate 2020 project. The EIA August 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 671, lists TECO SeaCoast Pipeline Project, operator SeaCoast Gas Transmission LLC, new pipeline, completed November 2010, Florida, 50 miles, cost 75 million dollars, intrastate. An Industrial Info article says the 50 mile line, a subsidiary of TECO Energy, was planned to serve the Greenland Energy Center in southeast Jacksonville, with an expected start-up in the fourth quarter of 2010. A Florida Public Service Commission order from November 2008 approved the SeaCoast intrastate tariff. Length 50 miles meets the 25 km rule. Not filled because sources disagree or are unclear: diameter (EIA says 20 and 24 inches, Industrial Info says 24 and 16 inches), capacity (EIA 100 million cubic feet per day, Industrial Info 500 million initial). Start state and exact endpoints in the field are approximate. No route found. The status of operating rests on the EIA completed entry alone. No independent confirmation of in-service yet. EIA is one origin, so tier is medium. Owner and parent not in the ownership list as exact matches; spelled SeaCoast Gas Transmission and TECO Energy.
